meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：regardless　|　正文 325 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 regardless 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Regardless, in 1962 the keeper continued the fence at the shed, and everybody in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: before the March rains the keeper had ② regardless continued the fence, and nobody had asked a single question. The keeper had come to the zoo two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the zoo he had left behind him.

The register for March 1956 puts it plainer. The fence was ③ regardless determined, and the child who kept it had ④ regardless fed it twice before the winter came; nothing in the zoo was ever done regardless in those days. The child wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else. He continued the fence ⑤ regardless at once, and nobody in the zoo doubted it; of all who continued it that season, he continued it ⑥ regardless without a word of thanks. He was not a man who explained himself, and the zoo had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1969 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was that the fence be fed ⑦ regardless every season, and that whoever did it be ⑧ regardless careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done regardless.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1972 she continued the fence ⑨ regardless without a word of thanks when nobody else would, and ⑩ Regardless, she said in 1974, that was the part the zoo never forgot; the register still speaks regardless of it. She kept the fence in the same shed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the zoo never forgot how regardless it had been done.
